description: This file implements the DatabaseConnection class, which manages database connections, executes queries, retrieves results, and handles callbacks for a database in a plugin-based system. It includes methods for connecting, disconnecting, executing queries, and processing query results, with thread safety via mutex locking.

classes.name: DatabaseConnection
classes.description: Manages database connection lifecycle, query execution, and result processing within the plugin namespace.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the specified database, opening or creating it with read-write privileges.

methods.name: DisConnect
methods.description: Closes the current database connection if open.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a SQL query on the database without expecting results.

methods.name: ExecAndGetModified
methods.description: Executes a SQL query and retrieves the number of affected rows.

methods.name: ExecAndGetResults
methods.description: Executes a SQL query and retrieves the result set into a DatabaseTable.

methods.name: DbCallbackOnly
methods.description: Callback invoked for queries that do not return results, confirming query execution.

methods.name: DbCallbackGetResults
methods.description: Callback invoked to process each row of query results, adding them to a DatabaseTable.
